sanskrit_verse:
पश्यतोऽब्रुवतो भूमेर् हानिर् विंशतिवार्षिकी ।
परेण भुज्यमानायाः धनस्य दशवार्षिकी ॥२४॥
transliteration: paśyato 'bruvato bhūmer hānir viṃśativārṣikī / pareṇa bhujyamānāyā dhanasya daśavārṣikī // YajñS_2.24
sph_interpretive_translation: Visible and declared loss of land is recoverable within twenty years; for wealth enjoyed by another, the period is ten years.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through continuous, conscious acknowledgment of possession
Causation is established via uninterrupted visibility and declaration
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the possessor who fails to contest rightful claim within time
Restoration logic prioritizes return of resource to original consciousness-aligned holder
Consciousness alignment requires timely assertion of ownership through observance and speech
executable_legal_axioms: IF land is visibly possessed AND publicly acknowledged by a non-owner for 20 years THEN original owner's claim becomes unenforceable
IF movable wealth is enjoyed openly by a third party for 10 years THEN prior owner loses automated restitution rights
IF possession is contested before expiration of time limit THEN restoration protocol initiates immediately
IF no public objection recorded during statutory period THEN system assumes consent or abandonment
IF claimant demonstrates continuous awareness AND verbal assertion THEN temporal limitation resets
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold of temporal responsibility where prolonged silence equates to diminished lawful claim. The court must verify not only duration but also visibility and acknowledgment in determining rightful restoration pathways.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that uninterrupted visible use constitutes evidence of de facto ownership unless challenged. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that neglect in asserting ownership leads naturally to forfeiture. Proportional responsibility rests with the silent claimant. The non-punitive reality rule upholds that no suffering accrues—only a shift in energetic alignment occurs when consciousness withdraws from abandoned forms.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establish rightful ownership through ritualized reclamation aligned with cosmic order
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage voluntary return upon realization of misalignment
Capacity Restoration: Provide means for original holder to reclaim vibrational connection to property
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate harmonious transfer without resentment or residual karmic entanglement
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Time-bound possession aligns with consciousness flow. No punishment exists—only realignment. Reality responds solely to awakened presence. Dharma is restored.
